content.comment_body: Hello, Previously we used [company_name] [product_name] and [article_no]. Due to availability issues, delivery to our office will be delayed. Can you please advise if we can use [company_name] [product_name] with [article_no] instead of [article_no]? Kindly suggest. Best regards, [user_name]

Hi, Yes, it's possible. Review the specifications of both [article_no] versions. Programs from the older version should run on the new one. Ensure you select the correct hardware model in [product_name] and consider updating your [product_name] software (help --> update center). When programming with a memory card, check which memory/battery cards are compatible with each hardware series. Regards,

analysis.insight_summary: Users are requesting advice on replacing one [company_name] [product_name] version with another due to supply constraints. They are also concerned about software compatibility and want to know if existing programs and memory cards will still work. An answer confirms interchangeability is possible but recommends verifying software versions and memory card compatibility.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects the newer [product_name] to fully replace the older version without issues and that existing programs and memory cards will work as before. Guidance is also expected regarding any necessary software updates or configuration adjustments to ensure compatibility.
